entry.content: • Better support for themes

entry.title: Taskbar Live HUD 1.1
entry.content:
• Added real-time CPU & RAM history mini-graph (Ctrl + Right Click).
  • Added default gateway (local router) ping option with zero internet traffic.
  • Switched network speed units to Mbps / Kbps.
  • Added custom background color setting (HEX).
  • Improved background transparency via per-pixel alpha (text and bars remain crisp).
  • Added font fallback for Windows 10 support.

entry.title: Taskbar AI Quota 2.18.1
entry.content:
Taskbar

  • Add eight tile styles: usage graph, segmented ring, concentric rings, gauge, clock pies, rounded square, headline % and quota matrix.
  • Add provider logos as account identity, with number badges for accounts that share a provider.
  • Add a Position setting for where the bars sit on the taskbar, and support for left and right taskbars.
  • Add warning marks on accounts while their provider's status page reports a problem.
  • Improve clicks: click a column to refresh it, and right-click it to hide the account or open its history.

Details flyout

  • Add a details flyout on hover, replacing the tooltip, with usage charts, reset times, pace and when each limit is projected to run out.
  • Add model and extra limits, the Claude plan, free resets and Antigravity's other quotas.

Usage history

  • Add usage history, recorded on this PC and on by default.
  • Add a history window that charts accounts together, overlays the previous week and exports CSV.

Providers

  • Add GitHub Copilot support for its monthly AI credits.
  • Add OpenCode Go support with its 5-hour, weekly and monthly limits.
  • Add Antigravity's Gemini Argon weekly quota.

Sign-in

  • Improve sign-in with a window to open or copy the link, Anthropic sign-in without pasting a code, and one-button Copilot sign-in.
  • Improve sign-in security by never following HTTP redirects.
  • Fix a new sign-in being overwritten by a token refresh that was already running.

Settings and notifications

  • Improve settings with a redesigned window and a live taskbar preview.
  • Add a custom usage color palette and a choice of window material.
  • Add notification levels; notifications now show under the mod's name, include the projected limit time and open the provider's dashboard.

Languages

  • Add German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian and Chinese translations.
  • Improve numbers to follow your Windows regional format.

Fixes

  • Fix duplicate polls, duplicate notifications and lost sign-ins when Explorer runs extra processes.
  • Fix a possible Explorer crash when the mod is disabled while a link opens.

Note: settings and sign-ins carry over, and the mod is renamed Taskbar AI Quota. Usage history recording is on by default; samples stay on this PC, and Settings > History turns it off.

entry.title: Lock Screen Live Wallpaper 1.0.0
entry.content:
Lock Screen Live Wallpaper

Plays a video as the background of the Windows 11 lock screen and the password / sign-in screen.

Preview video: "Stelle Cosmic Cheerleader" by u/iTaiizor, source. Character © HoYoverse. The video is not included in this mod.

The mod runs inside LogonUI.exe, decodes your video with Media Foundation, and feeds the frames into the XAML image elements that Windows normally uses for the lock screen wallpaper. If something looks wrong, a built-in fail-safe restores the original wallpaper.

⚠️ Before you start ⚠️

LogonUI.exe is a protected system process, so Windhawk does not inject into it by default. For this mod to work you must add it to Windhawk's process inclusion list:

  1. Open Windhawk and go to Settings → Advanced settings → More advanced settings.
  2. Add LogonUI.exe to the Process inclusion list and save.

📋 Requirements

  • Windows 11
  • LogonUI.exe added to Windhawk's process inclusion list (see above)
  • A video file that the SYSTEM account can read. LogonUI.exe runs as SYSTEM, so network locations, encrypted folders, and cloud-only (not downloaded) files may not work.

⚙️ Features

Feature Details
Video source One video file, or a folder (a random video is picked on every lock)
Formats mp4, m4v, mov, wmv, avi, mkv (anything Media Foundation can decode on your system; H.264 MP4 is recommended)
Fit modes Cover, fill, fit (letterbox), center
Playback speed 25% to 400%
Hardware decoding Decodes on the GPU (D3D11/DXVA) when possible, with automatic fallback to software decoding
Color adjustments Hue, saturation, brightness, contrast, gamma
Audio Plays the video's audio track when the volume is above 0
Power saving Still-frame mode, pause when idle, and optional pause on the password screen
Boot behavior Optionally show the last frame right after boot instead of decoding
Shutdown screen Optionally show the video on the "Shutting down" / "Restarting" screen (off by default, so Windows' own black screen is shown)
Fail-safe Restores the original wallpaper if the lock screen UI changes or the mod misbehaves
Debug log Optional CPU and decode statistics and a UI tree dump

📝 Notes on some settings

  • Render width: internal canvas width (320 to 1920). The height follows your screen's aspect ratio. This is the biggest CPU lever.
  • Hardware video decoding: on (default) decodes with the GPU when possible, which greatly lowers CPU use for 4K or 60 fps videos. Turn it off if playback glitches or the sign-in screen has problems. If the GPU path cannot produce a frame, the mod falls back to software decoding by itself. Changing this setting also re-enables playback if the crash guard turned it off.
  • Behavior right after boot: with Show last frame, the first 3 minutes after boot show the last saved frame without decoding. Needs at least one earlier session where the video was playing.
  • Audio volume: 0 means muted. Above 0, audio only plays at 100% speed while the video is playing (not paused, idle-paused, or showing the boot still frame).
  • Pause when idle: freezes the video and mutes the audio after the chosen time without input, and resumes on the next input.
  • Play video on the password screen: on (default) keeps the video playing while you type your password. Off freezes it on the password screen, which can help if playback stutters there, and it plays again on the lock screen.
  • Debug log: also writes debug.log in the mod's storage folder, with CPU and decode statistics every 5 seconds and one UI tree dump. Basic events always go to Windhawk's log (enable logging for the mod in Windhawk to see them).
  • Long playback: the video loops without any time limit. By default it freezes after 5 minutes without input (see Pause when idle); set that to 0 if you want it to keep playing while nobody is at the PC.

📈 Performance tips

  • Lower Render width (the default is 1920; for example try 1280 or 960).
  • Videos at 4K or 60 fps are decoded on the GPU when Hardware video decoding is on (the default). With it off they are decoded on the CPU and can use several cores; prefer 1080p at 30 fps then.
  • Use Pause if you only want a still image.
  • Keep Pause when idle enabled so nothing is decoded while nobody is at the PC.
  • If the video stutters while you type your password, turn off Play video on the password screen.
  • The password screen blurs the wallpaper behind it. A constantly changing background makes Windows redo that blur every frame, which costs some GPU time.

🔧 Troubleshooting

  • Normal wallpaper is shown: make sure LogonUI.exe is in the process inclusion list and the video path is correct, then turn on Debug log and read debug.log in the mod's storage folder (see "Files written by the mod"). Look for Failed to open video, Unsupported video format, or FAIL-SAFE TRIPPED. Enable Debug log for more detail.
  • Video will not open: try an H.264 MP4 stored somewhere the SYSTEM account can read.
  • No sound: set Audio volume above 0 and see the notes above.
  • Stuttering: lower the render width and enable Debug log, then check the CPU and UI stalls lines in the log.

🤔 How it works

  1. A worker thread finds the LogonUI Logon Window and installs a WH_GETMESSAGE hook on its UI thread.
  2. A decoder thread reads the video as RGB32 through Media Foundation, scales each frame according to the fit mode, applies the color settings, and publishes it to a shared buffer.
  3. On the UI thread, the newest frame is copied into a WriteableBitmap, which is set as the source of the LockLogonImage and SwapLockLogonImage elements.
  4. When the mod is unloaded, the original image sources are restored.

🛡️ Fail-safe

The mod stops itself and restores the original wallpaper for the rest of that LogonUI.exe process when:

  • the video decoder fails before producing any frame,
  • no video frame is produced within 30 seconds,
  • the lock screen elements (LockLogonImage / SwapLockLogonImage) are never found, which usually means a Windows update changed the UI, or
  • the UI throws repeated errors (3 within 30 seconds).

Separately, a crash guard protects the sign-in screen. If two LogonUI.exe sessions in a row end before the decoder shows its first frame (for example because a codec crashes on your video), the mod turns playback off and the normal wallpaper is shown. To turn it back on, change Video file or folder, Render width, Fit mode or Hardware video decoding to a different value and keep it. Very short sessions (for example two Ctrl+Alt+Del screens in a row) can also trip it; the same fix applies.

📁 Files written by the mod

Everything is stored in the mod's own storage folder inside Windhawk's data folder (the path below is for a regular install; a portable Windhawk keeps it elsewhere):

C:\ProgramData\Windhawk\Engine\ModsWritable\mod-storage\lock-screen-live-wallpaper

ProgramData is a hidden folder, so paste the path above into the File Explorer address bar to open it. The files are:

  • debug.log: log file, trimmed automatically after 2 MB
  • frame_*.bgra: cached first frame, so the lock screen can show something immediately
  • last.bgra: last shown frame, used by the Show last frame boot mode

You can delete these files at any time; the mod recreates what it needs. The folder is removed automatically when the mod is uninstalled.

☕ Support

If you enjoy this mod, you can support its development:

  • Ko-fi
  • Saweria (for Indonesia)

ℹ️ Disclaimer

Only tested on Windows 11 23H2 and 25H2. This mod runs inside a system UI process (LogonUI.exe), so it includes a fail-safe that restores the original wallpaper if anything goes wrong. As a precaution, keep another way to sign in available while trying it out.

Bahasa Indonesia

Memutar video sebagai latar belakang lock screen dan layar password / sign-in Windows 11.

Pratinjau video: "Stelle Cosmic Cheerleader" oleh u/iTaiizor, sumber. Karakter © HoYoverse. Videonya tidak disertakan dalam mod ini.

Mod ini berjalan di dalam LogonUI.exe, men-decode videomu dengan Media Foundation, lalu memasukkan frame-nya ke elemen gambar XAML yang biasanya dipakai Windows untuk wallpaper lock screen. Jika ada yang tidak beres, fail-safe bawaan akan mengembalikan wallpaper asli.

⚠️ Sebelum mulai ⚠️

LogonUI.exe adalah proses sistem yang dilindungi, jadi Windhawk tidak meng-inject ke dalamnya secara default. Agar mod ini berfungsi, kamu harus menambahkannya ke daftar inklusi proses Windhawk:

  1. Buka Windhawk lalu pergi ke Settings → Advanced settings → More advanced settings.
  2. Tambahkan LogonUI.exe ke Process inclusion list lalu simpan.

📋 Persyaratan

  • Windows 11
  • LogonUI.exe sudah ditambahkan ke daftar inklusi proses Windhawk (lihat di atas)
  • File video yang bisa dibaca akun SYSTEM. LogonUI.exe berjalan sebagai SYSTEM, sehingga lokasi jaringan, folder terenkripsi, dan file cloud-only (belum diunduh) mungkin tidak berfungsi.

⚙️ Fitur

Fitur Keterangan
Sumber video Satu file video, atau satu folder (video dipilih acak setiap kali dikunci)
Format mp4, m4v, mov, wmv, avi, mkv (apa pun yang bisa di-decode Media Foundation di sistemmu; MP4 H.264 disarankan)
Mode fit Cover, fill, fit (letterbox), center
Kecepatan putar 25% sampai 400%
Decoding hardware Men-decode di GPU (D3D11/DXVA) jika memungkinkan, dengan fallback otomatis ke decoding software
Penyesuaian warna Hue, saturasi, kecerahan, kontras, gamma
Audio Memutar audio video jika volume di atas 0
Hemat daya Mode gambar diam, jeda saat idle, dan opsi jeda di layar password
Perilaku saat boot Opsional menampilkan frame terakhir tepat setelah boot tanpa decoding
Layar shutdown Opsional menampilkan video di layar "Shutting down" / "Restarting" (mati secara default, sehingga layar hitam bawaan Windows yang tampil)
Fail-safe Mengembalikan wallpaper asli jika UI lock screen berubah atau mod bermasalah
Debug log Opsional: statistik CPU dan decode serta dump UI tree

📝 Catatan beberapa pengaturan

  • Render width: lebar kanvas internal (320 sampai 1920). Tinggi mengikuti rasio aspek layarmu. Ini pengaturan yang paling berpengaruh pada CPU.
  • Hardware video decoding: aktif (default) berarti video di-decode oleh GPU jika memungkinkan, sehingga pemakaian CPU turun jauh untuk video 4K atau 60 fps. Matikan jika pemutaran bermasalah atau layar sign-in bermasalah. Jika jalur GPU gagal menghasilkan frame, mod otomatis beralih ke decoding software. Mengubah setting ini juga menyalakan kembali pemutaran jika crash guard sempat mematikannya.
  • Behavior right after boot: dengan Show last frame, 3 menit pertama setelah boot menampilkan frame terakhir yang tersimpan tanpa decoding. Butuh minimal satu sesi sebelumnya di mana video sempat diputar.
  • Audio volume: 0 berarti senyap. Di atas 0, audio hanya diputar pada kecepatan 100% dan hanya saat video benar-benar berjalan (bukan saat dijeda, dijeda karena idle, atau menampilkan frame diam setelah boot).
  • Pause when idle: membekukan video dan membisukan audio setelah waktu tertentu tanpa input, lalu lanjut saat ada input berikutnya.
  • Play video on the password screen: aktif (default) berarti video tetap diputar saat kamu mengetik password. Jika dimatikan, video dibekukan di layar password (berguna jika video patah-patah di sana), dan diputar lagi di lock screen.
  • Debug log: juga menulis debug.log di folder penyimpanan mod, berisi statistik CPU dan decode setiap 5 detik dan satu kali dump UI tree. Peristiwa dasar selalu masuk ke log Windhawk (aktifkan logging untuk mod ini di Windhawk untuk melihatnya).
  • Pemutaran lama: video diulang tanpa batas waktu. Secara default video dibekukan setelah 5 menit tanpa input (lihat Pause when idle); setel ke 0 kalau kamu ingin video terus berjalan saat tidak ada orang di depan PC.

📈 Tips performa

  • Turunkan Render width (defaultnya 1920; misalnya coba 1280 atau 960).
  • Video 4K atau 60 fps di-decode oleh GPU saat Hardware video decoding aktif (default). Jika dimatikan, video di-decode oleh CPU dan bisa memakai beberapa core; pilih 1080p dengan 30 fps.
  • Gunakan Pause jika kamu hanya ingin gambar diam.
  • Biarkan Pause when idle aktif agar tidak ada decoding saat tidak ada orang di depan PC.
  • Jika video patah-patah saat mengetik password, matikan Play video on the password screen.
  • Layar password mem-blur wallpaper di belakangnya. Latar yang terus berubah membuat Windows mengulang blur itu di setiap frame, yang memakan sebagian GPU.

🔧 Pemecahan masalah

  • Wallpaper normal yang tampil: pastikan LogonUI.exe ada di daftar inklusi proses dan path video benar, lalu aktifkan Debug log dan baca debug.log di folder penyimpanan mod (lihat "File yang ditulis oleh mod"). Cari Failed to open video, Unsupported video format, atau FAIL-SAFE TRIPPED. Aktifkan Debug log untuk detail lebih banyak.
  • Video tidak mau terbuka: coba MP4 H.264 yang disimpan di tempat yang bisa dibaca akun SYSTEM.
  • Tidak ada suara: setel Audio volume di atas 0 dan baca catatan di atas.
  • Patah-patah: turunkan render width dan aktifkan Debug log, lalu cek baris CPU dan UI stalls di log.

🤔 Cara kerja

  1. Worker thread mencari LogonUI Logon Window dan memasang hook WH_GETMESSAGE pada UI thread-nya.
  2. Decoder thread membaca video sebagai RGB32 lewat Media Foundation, mengubah ukuran tiap frame sesuai mode fit, menerapkan pengaturan warna, lalu menaruhnya di buffer bersama.
  3. Di UI thread, frame terbaru disalin ke WriteableBitmap, yang dipasang sebagai source elemen LockLogonImage dan SwapLockLogonImage.
  4. Saat mod di-unload, source gambar asli dikembalikan.

🛡️ Fail-safe

Mod berhenti sendiri dan mengembalikan wallpaper asli sampai proses LogonUI.exe itu berakhir, jika:

  • decoder video gagal sebelum menghasilkan frame apa pun,
  • tidak ada frame video yang dihasilkan dalam 30 detik,
  • elemen lock screen (LockLogonImage / SwapLockLogonImage) tidak pernah ditemukan, yang biasanya berarti update Windows mengubah UI, atau
  • UI melempar error berulang (3 kali dalam 30 detik).

Selain itu, ada pelindung crash untuk layar sign-in. Jika dua sesi LogonUI.exe berturut-turut berakhir sebelum decoder menampilkan frame pertama (misalnya karena codec crash pada videomu), mod mematikan pemutaran dan wallpaper normal yang tampil. Untuk menyalakannya lagi, ubah Video file or folder, Render width, Fit mode atau Hardware video decoding ke nilai yang berbeda dan biarkan begitu. Sesi yang sangat singkat (misalnya dua kali layar Ctrl+Alt+Del berturut-turut) juga bisa memicunya; solusinya sama.

📁 File yang ditulis oleh mod

Semuanya disimpan di folder penyimpanan milik mod sendiri, di dalam folder data Windhawk (path di bawah untuk instalasi biasa; Windhawk portabel menyimpannya di tempat lain):

C:\ProgramData\Windhawk\Engine\ModsWritable\mod-storage\lock-screen-live-wallpaper

ProgramData adalah folder tersembunyi, jadi tempel path di atas ke address bar File Explorer untuk membukanya. Isinya:

  • debug.log: file log, dipangkas otomatis setelah 2 MB
  • frame_*.bgra: cache frame pertama, agar lock screen bisa langsung menampilkan sesuatu
  • last.bgra: frame terakhir yang ditampilkan, dipakai oleh mode boot Show last frame

Kamu boleh menghapus file-file ini kapan saja; mod akan membuat ulang yang dibutuhkan. Folder ini dihapus otomatis saat mod di-uninstall.

☕ Dukungan

Kalau kamu suka mod ini, kamu bisa mendukung pengembangannya lewat:

  • Saweria (untuk Indonesia)
  • Ko-fi (internasional)

ℹ️ Peringatan

Hanya diuji di Windows 11 23H2 dan 25H2. Mod ini berjalan di dalam proses UI sistem (LogonUI.exe), jadi sudah dilengkapi fail-safe yang mengembalikan wallpaper asli jika ada yang tidak beres. Sebagai langkah berjaga-jaga, siapkan cara lain untuk masuk ke Windows saat mencobanya.

entry.title: Quick Share Flyout 1.0.0
entry.content:
Quick Share Flyout

Opens Google's Quick Share for Windows as a flyout above the system tray, like the Windows 11 quick settings, instead of a window in the middle of the screen.

Click the Quick Share tray icon to open or close the flyout. If the icon is in the tray overflow menu, the flyout opens beside the menu.

Features

  • Opens above the tray icon and slides out from the taskbar
  • No title bar, with rounded corners
  • Stays above other windows, and closes when you click somewhere else
  • Drag files onto it from File Explorer
  • Moves notifications out of the way while it's open
  • Hidden from the taskbar and Alt+Tab
  • Adjustable size

Sending files

Drag files from File Explorer onto the flyout. It stays open while you drag and after you drop, until you click somewhere else. Clicking another window closes it, so pick the files first, then open the flyout and drag them in.

You can also right-click files and choose Send with Quick Share, or use Select in the flyout.

entry.title: Brave Acrylic 4.0
entry.content:
• Add independent Toolbar and Address bar settings. The Address bar option is on by default and removes Brave’s hover shadow on supported builds. If you previously disabled Toolbar to keep the address field opaque, turn Address bar off separately.
  • Enable Hide duplicate Windows buttons by default on fresh installs so affected users get a single set of controls without another setup step. The option can affect Alt+Space and taskbar menus. Turn it off to restore the original Windows window style.
  • Clear the backing around rounded webpage content while preserving its clipping and thin outline.
  • Add acrylic to Site information, Recent downloads and Media controls. Clear the download quick-action strip while preserving its controls.
  • Add adjustable popup tint opacity and use a short matching fade for supported bubbles and their backdrop.
  • Recognize Chromium 157’s virtual popup opacity setter and check for new stable Brave builds every hour.
  • Add an opt-in fallback to the official Brave symbol server. Windhawk checks the small cache first and can download the full PDB if needed. The fallback is off by default.

entry.title: Start Menu Category Manager 1.0.0
entry.content:
Start Menu Category Manager

Disclaimer: this mod is vibe coded. It was written with an AI assistant and tested only by its author on one setup. It changes what the Start menu reads from its category settings and restarts the Start menu process, so use it at your own risk and keep a backup of your layout (Export saves one).

Adds a Manage Categories item to the Windows 11 Start menu's context menu (right-click an empty area of the Start menu, next to Start settings).

Choosing Manage Categories closes the Start menu and opens the manager window.

The manager window always runs inside explorer.exe. The small part of the mod that runs inside the Start menu process only adds the menu item and asks Explorer to open the window. If the item does not show up, the Windhawk log (lines starting with [start]) shows whether the Start menu process found the Start settings item.

Whenever the mod is loaded (installed, updated, switched on again, or Explorer restarted), it restarts the Start menu process if that process started before the mod. The new process loads with the mod from its start, so the new menu item appears without restarting Explorer.

Your layout lives in this mod. The mod never writes to Windows' registry. It keeps the categories you choose in its own storage, and the part of the mod that runs inside the Start menu process gives Start your category when Start reads an app's category. If you disable or uninstall the mod, every category goes back to the one Windows chose, so keep the mod installed to keep your layout. Export saves a copy of it to a file. The layout belongs to the Windows account that made it: other accounts on the same PC keep their own.

Empty categories. In the category view of All apps, a category with no apps still shows up as an empty tile. The Hide empty category tiles option (on by default) hides those tiles, shows them again as soon as an app is assigned to the category, and lets the tiles after them move up to fill the gap. A tile counts as empty when its category holds no apps, so this does not depend on the display language, and pinned items and other tiles are never touched. This includes the empty Other container Windows 11 shows when you move every app out of Other. The option does not change any category and does not write to the registry. Changing it, like disabling the mod, restarts the Start menu process, because Start does not rebuild its category list every time the menu opens.

Export saves the category changes the mod applies (not Windows' own categories), including apps that are not installed, to a text file. Import adds such a file to your current changes. Export, Import and Reset all ask for confirmation first.

Reset all removes every change the mod applies, so every app goes back to the category Windows chose. It first writes a copy of your current layout to the mod's storage folder, which Import can load. Windhawk removes that folder together with the mod, so use Export if you want a copy that stays.

The manager lists every app the Start menu knows about (desktop apps and Microsoft Store apps, taken from shell:AppsFolder) and lets you assign a Start menu category to an app or to a whole Start menu folder.

Notes

  • Shortcuts inside a folder that contains two or more shortcuts are treated as a group: changing one changes the whole folder, because the Start menu groups them.
  • Choosing Windows default removes the mod's change for the app, so it goes back to the category Windows chose.
  • Applying a change restarts StartMenuExperienceHost so it takes effect immediately.
  • Windows keeps its categories under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Start\TileProperties. The mod only reads that key and never writes to it; its own changes are in the mod's storage.
  • Start sometimes keeps several keys for the same app (a P~ and a W~ twin, and one key per Start menu shortcut). The mod gives the app's main key and all of its other keys the same category, so they can never disagree. Apps whose keys currently disagree (Windows' own values, for apps you have not changed) get a yellow * after their name; hover it for details.
  • A heading with a red * after its name has 1 or 2 apps assigned to it, so Start folds those apps into a broader heading (see Category IDs below). A Start folder counts as one app, and Other is never marked. Hover the name for the same explanation. The list reloads by itself when a change makes a heading reach or leave that range.
  • A folder whose apps are in different categories shows Mixed in its drop-down. Click a folder's card, or its arrow, to expand or collapse it.
  • Press F5 (or click the refresh button) to reload the app list. The refresh icon turns once and the status text blinks once, so you can see it went through.
  • Hover any drop-down and turn the mouse wheel to go through its options. In a row's drop-down the new category is applied once the wheel has rested for about a second.
  • The ID box at the bottom only appears after you choose Custom ID... in the bottom drop-down. Press Enter in it to apply the ID to the ticked apps straight away.
  • Click an app's row (not its check box or drop-down) to see the registry key it uses in the status bar, below TileProperties, and how many other keys it has. A Start folder has no key of its own, so clicking its card shows how many apps it holds; each app inside shows its own key.
  • The window follows the Windows display language: English, or Brazilian Portuguese (including the right-click menu item, Gerenciar Categorias).
  • The drop-down next to the search box filters the list by the category assigned to each app. Check all ticks or unticks everything shown, and Expand all / Collapse all opens or closes every folder.
  • Each entry of the category filter shows how many apps are assigned to it. The numbers count every app, not only the ones the search currently shows. Apps whose stored ID is not in the list are counted only under All categories.
  • The Sort drop-down orders the list: A to Z, Z to A, by category ID (low to high or high to low), by category name, or with apps whose keys disagree first. Apps that have no override (Windows default) have no ID and are listed last in the ID and category orders. A folder is placed by the lowest ID among its apps (the highest for "high to low"). The order also applies inside each folder.
  • Tick the boxes next to apps or folders to change many at once, then pick a category in the bottom drop-down and press Apply to ticked apps. It acts on every ticked app.
  • Right-click an app or a folder card and choose Open file location to open the Start menu folder that holds its shortcut in File Explorer. For an app, the shortcut is selected. Apps without a Start menu shortcut (most Microsoft Store apps) have the item greyed out; clicking it says why in the status bar.
  • Start stores a number per app. Choose Custom ID... to try any number from 0 to 999. The list shows each app's stored ID, so you can see which number Start itself used for an app that already sits under the heading you want.

Category IDs

Microsoft publishes no list of the numbers Start uses, so these were found by testing on Windows 11 26H2 (build 26300), with Windows in Brazilian Portuguese. The names below are translations of the headings Start showed, so they may differ from what Start shows in English.

Heading IDs
Accessibility 1
Business 20
Creativity 6, 7, 22, 23, 30
Developer Tools 15
Education 19
Entertainment 16
Food & Dining 29
Games 3
Health & Fitness 12
Information & Reading 14, 21, 24, 25, 31
Kids & Family 10
Lifestyle 27
Medical 11
Music 17
Other 0
Personal Finance 18
Productivity 2, 5, 13
Shopping 28
Social 8
Sports 26
Travel 4
Utilities & Tools 9
  • Several IDs lead to the same heading (for example 2, 5 and 13 all show under Productivity).
  • Start only shows a heading as its own tile when at least 3 apps are assigned to it. With fewer, those apps are shown under a broader heading, even though their ID is unchanged: Games, Music and Sports fall under Entertainment, and Travel, Medical, Health & Fitness, Personal Finance, Shopping and Food & Dining fall under Lifestyle. Give a third app the same ID and the tile appears by itself.
  • An app inside a Start menu folder seems to count as one app, however many apps the folder holds.
  • IDs above 31 have no name. An ID above 31 with 3 or more apps gets a heading with no title, and with fewer apps those apps fall under Other, so stay with the IDs above.

Start menu restarts

Applying a change, Import, Reset all, loading the mod and disabling or removing it all restart the Start menu process, so Start can flash or close for a moment each time. A restart is skipped when nothing actually changed, and a Start process that started within the last second is left alone.

Uninstalling or disabling

The mod makes no permanent change to Windows' own category values. When it is disabled, uninstalled or updated, the Start menu process restarts and reads its own values again, so every category goes back to the one Windows chose. Your layout stays in the mod's storage while the mod is installed, so disabling and enabling the mod (or updating it) brings your categories back. Windhawk removes the storage together with the mod, so use Export first if you want to keep your layout.

Tested on

Only Windows 11 build 26300, on one x64 computer, with Windows in Brazilian Portuguese. The mod has not been tested on ARM64, because I have no ARM64 device. On any other build the mod may fail to attach to the Start menu (see below).

If a Windows update breaks the mod

The mod depends on private parts of the Start menu that Microsoft can change without notice. It was written and tested on Windows 11 build 26300. When something stops matching, the mod keeps running and only the affected part stops working. What you may see:

  • No "Manage Categories" item in the Start menu's right-click menu. The menu hook did not attach. Windows then also shows a one-time message per Windows build.
  • Your categories stop applying (the manager still opens and lists them). The hook on RegGetValueW in kernelbase.dll, which gives Start your category, is not being used by this build of Start. The log lines starting with [start] say whether it was installed and whether it served a category.
  • Empty tiles are not hidden, or are hidden but the other tiles do not move up. The hooks for the Hide empty category tiles option were not found (all of them are optional). If only the ReplaceAll hook is missing, the empty tiles are still hidden and only the gaps return. The menu item and your categories are not affected.

Where to look: the Windhawk log (lines starting with [start]) says whether the hooks were found. The function the mod needs in the Start menu DLL (StartMenu.dll, or StartUI.dll on some builds) is consume_..._IVector<IVector<MenuFlyoutItemBase>>::Append, which adds the menu item. The empty-tile option also uses CategoryProvider::PruneAndCombineCategories, StartBlendedFlexFrame::OnContextRequested and the ReplaceAll of the category list (AllAppsGroupViewModel), all optional. To find their new names after an update, search the Start menu DLL's symbols in Windhawk for those class and function names. The mod also hooks RegGetValueW in kernelbase.dll inside the Start menu process, which StartTileData.dll uses to read each app's Category value.

Gerenciador de Categorias do Menu Iniciar

Aviso: este mod foi feito com "vibe coding". Foi escrito com um assistente de IA e testado apenas pelo autor, em uma única configuração. Ele altera o que o menu Iniciar lê das suas configurações de categoria e reinicia o processo do menu Iniciar, então use por sua conta e risco e guarde um backup do seu layout (Exportar salva um).

Adiciona o item Gerenciar Categorias ao menu de contexto do menu Iniciar do Windows 11 (clique com o botão direito em uma área vazia do menu Iniciar, ao lado do item de configurações do Iniciar).

Ao escolher Gerenciar Categorias, o menu Iniciar fecha e a janela do gerenciador abre.

A janela do gerenciador sempre roda dentro do explorer.exe. A pequena parte do mod que roda dentro do processo do menu Iniciar apenas adiciona o item de menu e pede ao Explorer que abra a janela. Se o item não aparecer, o log do Windhawk (linhas que começam com [start]) mostra se o processo do menu Iniciar encontrou o item de configurações do Iniciar.

Sempre que o mod é carregado (instalado, atualizado, ativado novamente ou com o Explorer reiniciado), ele reinicia o processo do menu Iniciar caso esse processo tenha começado antes do mod. O novo processo já carrega o mod desde o início, então o novo item de menu aparece sem reiniciar o Explorer.

Seu layout fica neste mod. O mod nunca grava no registro do Windows. Ele guarda as categorias que você escolhe no seu próprio armazenamento, e a parte do mod que roda dentro do processo do menu Iniciar entrega a sua categoria ao Iniciar quando ele lê a categoria de um app. Se você desativar ou desinstalar o mod, todas as categorias voltam para a que o Windows escolheu, então mantenha o mod instalado para manter o seu layout. Exportar salva uma cópia dele em um arquivo. O layout pertence à conta do Windows que o criou: outras contas no mesmo PC mantêm as suas.

Categorias vazias. Na visualização por categorias de Todos os aplicativos, uma categoria sem apps ainda aparece como um bloco vazio. A opção Hide empty category tiles (ocultar blocos de categorias vazias, ativada por padrão) oculta esses blocos, mostra-os de novo assim que um app é atribuído à categoria e faz os blocos seguintes subirem para preencher o espaço. Um bloco conta como vazio quando a categoria não contém apps, então isso não depende do idioma de exibição, e itens fixados e outros blocos nunca são alterados. Isso inclui o contêiner Outro vazio que o Windows 11 mostra quando você move todos os apps para fora de Outro. A opção não altera nenhuma categoria e não grava no registro. Alterá-la, assim como desativar o mod, reinicia o processo do menu Iniciar, porque o Iniciar não reconstrói a lista de categorias toda vez que o menu abre.

Exportar salva em um arquivo de texto as alterações de categoria que o mod aplica (não as categorias do próprio Windows), incluindo apps que não estão instalados. Importar adiciona esse arquivo às suas alterações atuais. Exportar, Importar e Redefinir tudo pedem confirmação antes.

Redefinir tudo remove todas as alterações que o mod aplica, então todos os apps voltam para a categoria que o Windows escolheu. Antes, ele grava uma cópia do seu layout atual na pasta de armazenamento do mod, que o Importar consegue carregar. O Windhawk remove essa pasta junto com o mod, então use Exportar se quiser uma cópia que fique.

O gerenciador lista todos os apps que o menu Iniciar conhece (apps da área de trabalho e apps da Microsoft Store, obtidos de shell:AppsFolder) e permite atribuir uma categoria do menu Iniciar a um app ou a uma pasta inteira do menu Iniciar.

Observações

  • Atalhos dentro de uma pasta que contém dois ou mais atalhos são tratados como um grupo: alterar um altera a pasta inteira, porque o menu Iniciar os agrupa.
  • Escolher Padrão do Windows remove a alteração do mod para o app, que volta para a categoria que o Windows escolheu.
  • Aplicar uma alteração reinicia o StartMenuExperienceHost para que ela tenha efeito imediatamente.
  • O Windows guarda suas categorias em HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Start\TileProperties. O mod apenas lê essa chave e nunca grava nela; as alterações do mod ficam no armazenamento do próprio mod.
  • O Iniciar às vezes mantém várias chaves para o mesmo app (uma gêmea P~ e outra W~, e uma chave por atalho do menu Iniciar). O mod dá à chave principal do app e a todas as outras chaves a mesma categoria, para que nunca divirjam. Apps cujas chaves divergem no momento (valores do próprio Windows, para apps que você não alterou) recebem um * amarelo depois do nome; passe o mouse sobre ele para ver detalhes.
  • Um título com um * vermelho depois do nome tem 1 ou 2 apps atribuídos, então o Iniciar dobra esses apps em um título mais amplo (veja IDs de categoria abaixo). Uma pasta do Iniciar conta como um app, e Outro nunca é marcado. Passe o mouse sobre o nome para ver a mesma explicação. A lista recarrega sozinha quando uma alteração faz um título entrar ou sair dessa faixa.
  • Uma pasta cujos apps estão em categorias diferentes mostra Misto na lista suspensa. Clique no cartão da pasta, ou na seta dela, para expandir ou recolher.
  • Pressione F5 (ou clique no botão de atualizar) para recarregar a lista de apps. O ícone de atualizar gira uma vez e o texto de status pisca uma vez, para você ver que funcionou.
  • Passe o mouse sobre qualquer lista suspensa e gire a roda do mouse para percorrer as opções. Na lista suspensa de uma linha, a nova categoria é aplicada quando a roda fica parada por cerca de um segundo.
  • A caixa de ID na parte de baixo só aparece depois que você escolhe ID personalizado... na lista suspensa de baixo. Pressione Enter nela para aplicar o ID aos apps marcados imediatamente.
  • Clique na linha de um app (não na caixa de seleção nem na lista suspensa) para ver na barra de status a chave de registro que ele usa, abaixo de TileProperties, e quantas outras chaves ele tem. Uma pasta do Iniciar não tem chave própria, então clicar no cartão dela mostra quantos apps ela contém; cada app dentro mostra a sua própria chave.
  • A janela segue o idioma de exibição do Windows: inglês ou português do Brasil (incluindo o item do menu de contexto, Gerenciar Categorias).
  • A lista suspensa ao lado da caixa de pesquisa filtra a lista pela categoria atribuída a cada app. Marcar tudo marca ou desmarca tudo o que está sendo exibido, e Expandir tudo / Recolher tudo abre ou fecha todas as pastas.
  • Cada entrada do filtro de categorias mostra quantos apps estão atribuídos a ela. Os números contam todos os apps, não apenas os que a pesquisa mostra no momento. Apps cujo ID armazenado não está na lista são contados apenas em todas as categorias.
  • A lista suspensa Ordem organiza a lista: A a Z, Z a A, por ID de categoria (crescente ou decrescente), por nome da categoria, ou com os apps de chaves divergentes primeiro. Apps sem alteração (Padrão do Windows) não têm ID e ficam por último nas ordens por ID e por categoria. Uma pasta é posicionada pelo menor ID entre seus apps (o maior, em "decrescente"). A ordem também vale dentro de cada pasta.
  • Marque as caixas ao lado de apps ou pastas para alterar vários de uma vez, depois escolha uma categoria na lista suspensa de baixo e clique em Aplicar aos marcados. Isso vale para todos os apps marcados.
  • Clique com o botão direito em um app ou no cartão de uma pasta e escolha Abrir local do arquivo para abrir no Explorador de Arquivos a pasta do menu Iniciar que guarda o atalho dele. Para um app, o atalho fica selecionado. Apps sem atalho no menu Iniciar (a maioria dos apps da Microsoft Store) têm o item desabilitado; clicar nele explica o motivo na barra de status.
  • O Iniciar guarda um número por app. Escolha ID personalizado... para testar qualquer número de 0 a 999. A lista mostra o ID armazenado de cada app, para você ver qual número o próprio Iniciar usou para um app que já está sob o título que você quer.

IDs de categoria

A Microsoft não publica uma lista dos números que o Iniciar usa, então estes foram encontrados por testes no Windows 11 26H2 (build 26300). Os nomes abaixo são os títulos exatamente como o Iniciar os mostra em português do Brasil.

Título IDs
Acessibilidade 1
Bares e Restaurantes 29
Comercial 20
Compras 28
Crianças + Família 10
Criatividade 6, 7, 22, 23, 30
Educação 19
Entretenimento 16
Esportes 26
Estilo de vida 27
Ferramentas de Desenvolvedor 15
Finanças Pessoais 18
Informações e Leitura 14, 21, 24, 25, 31
Jogos 3
Medicina 11
Música 17
Outro 0
Produtividade 2, 5, 13
Saúde e Bem-estar 12
Social 8
Utilitários e Ferramentas 9
Viagem 4
  • Vários IDs levam ao mesmo título (por exemplo, 2, 5 e 13 aparecem todos em Produtividade).
  • O Iniciar só mostra um título como bloco próprio quando pelo menos 3 apps estão atribuídos a ele. Com menos, esses apps aparecem sob um título mais amplo, mesmo que o ID não mude: Jogos, Música e Esportes ficam em Entretenimento, e Viagem, Medicina, Saúde e Bem-estar, Finanças Pessoais, Compras e Bares e Restaurantes ficam em Estilo de vida. Dê o mesmo ID a um terceiro app e o bloco aparece sozinho.
  • Um app dentro de uma pasta do menu Iniciar parece contar como um app, não importa quantos apps a pasta contenha.
  • IDs acima de 31 não têm nome. Um ID acima de 31 com 3 ou mais apps ganha um título sem nome, e com menos apps esses apps ficam em Outro, então use os IDs até 31.

Reinicializações do menu Iniciar

Aplicar uma alteração, Importar, Redefinir tudo, carregar o mod e desativá-lo ou removê-lo reiniciam o processo do menu Iniciar, então o Iniciar pode piscar ou fechar por um instante a cada vez. A reinicialização é ignorada quando nada mudou de fato, e um processo do Iniciar que começou há menos de um segundo é deixado em paz.

Desinstalar ou desativar

O mod não faz nenhuma alteração permanente nos valores de categoria do próprio Windows. Quando ele é desativado, desinstalado ou atualizado, o processo do menu Iniciar reinicia e lê seus próprios valores de novo, então todas as categorias voltam para a que o Windows escolheu. Seu layout fica no armazenamento do mod enquanto ele estiver instalado, então desativar e ativar o mod (ou atualizá-lo) traz suas categorias de volta. O Windhawk remove o armazenamento junto com o mod, então use Exportar antes se quiser guardar o seu layout.

Testado em

Apenas no Windows 11 build 26300, em um computador x64, com o Windows em português do Brasil. O mod não foi testado em ARM64, porque não tenho um dispositivo ARM64. Em qualquer outro build, o mod pode não conseguir se conectar ao menu Iniciar (veja abaixo).

Se uma atualização do Windows quebrar o mod

O mod depende de partes privadas do menu Iniciar que a Microsoft pode alterar sem aviso. Ele foi escrito e testado no Windows 11 build 26300. Quando algo deixa de corresponder, o mod continua rodando e apenas a parte afetada deixa de funcionar. O que você pode ver:

  • Sem o item "Gerenciar Categorias" no menu de contexto do menu Iniciar. O hook do menu não foi conectado. O Windows também mostra uma mensagem única por build do Windows.
  • Suas categorias deixam de ser aplicadas (o gerenciador ainda abre e as lista). O hook em RegGetValueW na kernelbase.dll, que entrega a sua categoria ao Iniciar, não está sendo usado por este build do Iniciar. As linhas de log que começam com [start] dizem se ele foi instalado e se entregou uma categoria.
  • Blocos vazios não são ocultados, ou são ocultados mas os outros blocos não sobem. Os hooks da opção Hide empty category tiles não foram encontrados (todos são opcionais). Se apenas o hook de ReplaceAll estiver faltando, os blocos vazios continuam ocultos e só os espaços voltam. O item de menu e suas categorias não são afetados.

Onde procurar: o log do Windhawk (linhas que começam com [start]) diz se os hooks foram encontrados. A função que o mod precisa na DLL do menu Iniciar (StartMenu.dll, ou StartUI.dll em alguns builds) é consume_..._IVector<IVector<MenuFlyoutItemBase>>::Append, que adiciona o item de menu. A opção de blocos vazios também usa CategoryProvider::PruneAndCombineCategories, StartBlendedFlexFrame::OnContextRequested e o ReplaceAll da lista de categorias (AllAppsGroupViewModel), todos opcionais. Para encontrar os novos nomes depois de uma atualização, procure os símbolos da DLL do menu Iniciar no Windhawk por esses nomes de classe e função. O mod também conecta RegGetValueW na kernelbase.dll dentro do processo do menu Iniciar, que a StartTileData.dll usa para ler o valor Category de cada app.

entry.title: Super Shortcuts for Mouse 1.0
entry.content:
Super Shortcuts for Mouse

English · Türkçe · Deutsch · Français · Русский

Hold a mouse button, then click or scroll with another one to run an action on the window under the cursor: close, minimize, maximize or restore it, snap it, toggle always-on-top, skip to the next / previous track, play / pause, change the volume, show the desktop, switch virtual desktops, take a screenshot and more.

How it works

  • Hold button (choose in the settings):
    • Right mouse button (default)
    • Back (side) mouse button
    • Forward (side) mouse button
  • While it is held, these inputs are available as triggers, and each can be assigned any action in the settings: left click, middle click, scroll wheel up / down, the other side button, and the right button (side-button mode only).
  • Window actions always apply to the window under the mouse cursor, not to the active window.
  • Default mapping: left click = close, middle click = play / pause, wheel up = maximize, wheel down = minimize, Back = previous track, Forward = next track, right click (side-button mode) = always on top.
  • If you press and release the hold button without using any trigger, it works as a normal click (context menu, browser back / forward...). Right-button drags are detected and passed through to the application unchanged.
  • The language (English, Turkish, German, French, Russian) follows your Windows display language automatically. Other languages fall back to English.

Notes

  • The mod runs in windhawk.exe and uses a global low-level mouse hook.
  • Windows that run as administrator ignore requests from a non-elevated process. To control them, run Windhawk as administrator.
  • Synthetic mouse events from other programs are not affected, and the mod is disabled while a fullscreen app / game is active (can be turned off).
  • "None" assigned to a trigger blocks that input while the hold button is down.

Türkçe

Bir fare tuşunu basılı tutup başka bir tuşa tıklayarak ya da tekerleği çevirerek imlecin altındaki pencerede işlev çalıştırın: kapat, simge durumuna küçült, büyüt, eski boyuta getir, yasla, her zaman üstte, sonraki / önceki şarkı, oynat / duraklat, ses, masaüstünü göster, sanal masaüstü değiştir, ekran görüntüsü ve daha fazlası.

  • Basılı tutulacak tuş: sağ fare tuşu (varsayılan), Geri veya İleri yan tuşu.
  • Tuş basılıyken sol tık, orta tık, tekerlek yukarı / aşağı, diğer yan tuş ve (yalnızca yan tuş modunda) sağ tık tetikleyici olarak kullanılabilir; her birine ayarlardan istediğiniz işlevi atayabilirsiniz.
  • Pencere işlevleri her zaman etkin pencereye değil, fare imlecinin altındaki pencereye uygulanır.
  • Tuşa hiçbir tetikleyici kullanmadan basıp bırakırsanız normal tıklama gibi çalışır.
  • Dil, Windows görüntü dilinize göre otomatik seçilir; desteklenmeyen diller için İngilizce kullanılır.
  • Yönetici olarak çalışan pencereleri de kontrol etmek için Windhawk'u yönetici olarak çalıştırın. Tam ekran uygulama / oyun açıkken mod devre dışı kalır.

Deutsch

Halten Sie eine Maustaste gedrückt und klicken oder scrollen Sie mit einer anderen, um eine Aktion für das Fenster unter dem Mauszeiger auszuführen: schließen, minimieren, maximieren, andocken, immer im Vordergrund, Titel überspringen, Wiedergabe/Pause, Lautstärke, Desktop anzeigen, virtuelle Desktops wechseln, Screenshot und mehr. Die Sprache folgt automatisch der Windows-Anzeigesprache (sonst Englisch).

Français

Maintenez un bouton de la souris, puis cliquez ou faites défiler avec un autre pour exécuter une action sur la fenêtre située sous le curseur : fermer, réduire, agrandir, ancrer, toujours au premier plan, changer de piste, lecture/pause, volume, afficher le bureau, changer de bureau virtuel, capture d'écran, etc. La langue suit automatiquement celle de Windows (sinon l'anglais).

Русский

Удерживайте одну кнопку мыши и щёлкайте или прокручивайте колесо другой, чтобы выполнить действие над окном под курсором: закрыть, свернуть, развернуть, прикрепить, поверх всех окон, переключить трек, воспроизведение/пауза, громкость, показать рабочий стол, сменить виртуальный рабочий стол, снимок экрана и другое. Язык выбирается автоматически по языку интерфейса Windows (иначе английский).

entry.title: Touchpad Relaxed Hand Tracking 1.0.0
entry.content:
Touchpad Relaxed Hand Tracking

Move the pointer with more fingers resting on the precision touchpad, as if gliding a weightless mouse. Your hand can relax with more natural finger movements, instead of holding a single digit position over the pad.

How it works

  • Trigger: with 5 (or as few as configured) fingers touching the pad.
  • Disarm: after all fingers leave the touchpad. Lifting some keeps the glide going.
  • Movement: each finger weighs as much as it moves, so resting fingers drop out and one which lags (usually the thumb) doesn't fight the others. With one or two fingers moving, the lower speed multiplier applies; with more moving together, the higher one.
  • Click: you don't need to lift all fingers. With more fingers resting, same as native - single finger (double) tap to (double) click, tap and hold to drag, tap-tap and hold to drag-select text. A hold lasts until another tap or the whole hand leaves the pad.
  • Scrolling: Windows 2-finger scroll is ignored while more-fingers-gliding. Instead, 2-finger tap-slide to scroll, while "inside" the more-fingers action (or with 2 fingers detection enabled). Both will get activated if you start with 2 and rest more on the touchpad.

4 and 3 fingers detection

The options to start with four or three fingers conflict with the respective Windows swipes. Disable them in Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Touchpad → Four-finger gestures (or Three) → Swipes: Nothing. Otherwise Windows simultaneously triggers the swipe. Four and three-finger taps can keep their actions. If the Three Finger Drag mod is installed and set to the same finger count, both mods respond to the same swipe, so give them different counts.

2 fingers detection

When active, two fingers do everything: glide, right click (tap) and scroll (tap-drag). Windows' own two-finger gestures have to be disabled in Settings → Bluetooth & devices → Touchpad: uncheck Scroll & zoom → Drag two fingers to scroll and Taps → Tap with two fingers to right-click. Otherwise both commands respond. On Windhawk 1.x, with two-finger detection active, programs running as administrator get no two-finger scroll at all, since Windows' will be disabled and the mod can't reach them.

Speed

The mod learns the touchpad's native speed and acceleration by watching ordinary one-finger use: for each range of finger speed, it compares how far the finger moved with how far Windows moved the pointer. The glide reproduces that curve, and the multipliers apply on top of it: 1.0 is the same as native, 1.5 is 50% faster. When the touchpad speed is changed in Windows settings, the curve adjusts with use.

Right after installing, before anything is learned, the glide uses a default speed. Using the touchpad normally for a few minutes, with slow and fast movements, is enough for it to learn.

Limitations

  • Requires a precision touchpad.
  • Windows gestures can't be blocked by the mod. Windows picks the gesture by the fingers that came down last: starting with one finger and then resting four more, or lifting and resting fingers again, triggers the gesture for that count. Disabling Windows three and four fingers swipes removes the conflict.
  • Programs running as administrator need Windhawk 2. On Windhawk 1.x, while one is in the foreground, Windows doesn't communicate with the mod, and only the native gestures work.
  • Movements against the edge of the screen don't teach the curve, since the pointer stops there while the finger goes on.

Credits

Reading the touchpad follows the approach of the Three Finger Drag mod by RodrigoThomazi, under the GPL v3.

entry.title: Drag to Scroll 1.2.0
entry.content:
✨ New Features

  • Right-Click Only Trigger Mode: Added a trigger_mode setting to switch between Ctrl + Right-Click and Right-Click Only (cruising is automatically disabled in Right-Click Only mode).
  • 5-Tier Dynamic Velocity Mode: Replaced the old enable_velocity toggle with velocity_mode (Off, Gentle, Standard, Fast, UltraFast). Note for upgrading users: the new Standard default is gentler and more controlled than v1.1.0; select Ultra Fast if you prefer the stronger v1.1.0 flick boost.
  • Configurable Cruising Anchor: Added cruise_anchor to start hands-free cruising by holding Right-Click (default), Ctrl, or Either. Note for upgrading users: If you used cruising in v1.1.0, select Hold Ctrl to keep the old gesture.
  • Out-of-Bounds Dragging: Added allow_out_of_bounds to keep scrolling even when the cursor leaves the target window.

🛠️ Bug Fixes & Stability

  • Cross-Process Cruise Cancellation: Added per-session shared-memory coordination so clicking on other hooked desktop apps during Ctrl-anchored cruising stops the glide cleanly and swallows the stop-click (with instant fallback for unhooked, UWP, or elevated surfaces).
  • Swapped Mouse Button Support: Added SM_SWAPBUTTON handling so right-click tap replay, RMB-anchored cruising, and cancel checks work properly for left-handed mouse setups.
  • Scroll Target & Capture Reliability: Locked wheel scroll delivery to the initial target window via PostMessageW, deferred window activation until past the deadzone, and added GetCapture() loss recovery (e.g., on Alt+Tab or modal dialogs) without rogue context menus.
  • Cursor & Modifier Polish: Suppressed deadzone cursor changes in Right-Click Only mode, improved arrow cursor restoration when scrolling ends, and refined Ctrl masking during scroll drain to prevent accidental browser zooming.
  • Thread & Unload Safety: Refactored state synchronization with CRITICAL_SECTION and atomics, hardened Base64 cursor bounds and alignment checks, joined the cruise worker in Wh_ModBeforeUninit, and updated @exclude entries (conhost.exe, ShellExperienceHost.exe, Widgets.exe).

📝 Documentation

  • Added a Recommended Settings section to the README (highlighting why the Hold Right-Click cruising anchor prevents click leaks across elevated, UWP, and system windows) and updated settings descriptions to cover trigger trade-offs and compatibility notes.

entry.title: Pointer Afterimage Motion Blur 1.2
entry.content:
• No more trail across the screen when the pointer jumps across a large part of the screen, such as with PowerToys Cursor Wrap.
  • Fixes flickering hover highlights in Office menus (such as Excel's recent files) while the blur is drawn. The overlay window used to move and resize with the blur on every frame, and Windows reports each of those changes to the window under the pointer as a mouse move. Now the window stays put while the pointer is still and only its picture changes.
  • The blur is now the same size as the pointer at 125% and 175% scaling; it was drawn up to 25% larger there. Windows scales the pointer in steps (the same size at 100% and 125%), not by the exact scaling.
  • A new pointer size is picked up the next time the mouse moves after a pause; before, the blur kept the old size until the mod was restarted.
  • A little less CPU for the mod and dwm.exe while the blur is drawn. Memory goes up to 7-8 MB (more on larger screens) for short bursts while the blur is drawn (the window is now larger than the blur) and drops back once the mouse stops.

entry.title: WinTips OSD 1.5.0

entry.title: Lock Screen Clock Styler 0.6.0
entry.content:

  • Fixed black lock screen background after laptop wakes up from sleep (#6978) via native display and power state callbacks (PowerSettingRegisterNotification & RegisterSuspendResumeNotification) to pause background polling during quiesce.
  • Added a 1000 ms stabilization delay upon wake before resuming clock ticks, preventing contention while LockApp's COM and DXGI pipelines restore wallpaper.
  • Added window and element visibility guards (IsWindowVisible & Window::Current().Visible()) before inspecting or modifying the visual tree.

  • Updated README and mod header previews with new vertical clock screenshots.

entry.title: Better Eject Dialog 1.0
entry.content:
Better Eject Dialog

When a USB drive is in use, Windows refuses to eject it with a message like "Problem Ejecting USB Attached SCSI (UAS) Mass Storage Device. This device is currently in use. Close any programs or windows that might be using the device, and then try again." It doesn't say which program is using the drive.

Before After

This mod replaces that message with a dialog that:

  • Lists the programs that are using the drive, with their name, process ID, path and command line. Background helpers get a clearer name, for example COM Surrogate (Plan9FileSystem) for the server that WSL uses to access Windows drives.
  • Explains common causes, such as WSL, Windows Search, Microsoft Defender and File Explorer.
  • Closes or ends a program with one click. Programs with windows are asked to close, so they can still ask you to save your work. Background processes are ended. Programs that run as administrator get a UAC prompt.
  • Ejects automatically once the blocking programs exit, so you can leave the dialog open and close them yourself. If the drive keeps being used, it stops after 5 attempts in a row until you click a button.
  • Force ejects as a last resort. After a confirmation and a UAC prompt, the drive is flushed and dismounted so that programs lose access to it, and then it's ejected. Programs may lose unsaved changes to files on the drive.
  • Keeps Windows' usual Safe To Remove Hardware notification when the drive is ejected.

It works when you eject from the Safely Remove Hardware and Eject Media tray icon and from Eject in File Explorer.

How it finds the programs

Every time an eject fails, Windows writes an event to the System event log (Kernel-PnP, event ID 225) for each process that has the drive open. The mod reads those events, so it can also name programs that run as administrator, services and Windows itself.

What it doesn't close

  • System means that Windows or a driver has the drive open, for example for indexing, virus scanning, WSL or a mounted disk image. It usually lets go once the other programs are closed. If it doesn't, use Force eject.
  • File Explorer can't be closed from the dialog, because the dialog runs inside it. Close File Explorer windows or previews that show the drive.
  • Windows services and core Windows processes are listed so that you know what's using the drive, but they aren't closed from the dialog.

Notes

  • Ejects started by other programs, such as third-party eject tools, aren't changed.
  • Force eject can lose unsaved changes that programs still have for files on the drive. Use it only if you can't close the programs.

entry.title: File Explorer WinUI-Like Content Animation 1.0.3
entry.content:
• Keep DirectUI text visible during animations: in light mode it could vanish or turn into faint white artifacts until the animation ended.
  • Move only the scrollable area on page entrance, so the column header no longer turns opaque or changes color during the animation with translucent backgrounds.
  • Hand the content back under a copy that follows the scroll when scrolling during an animation, so it no longer flashes empty, also with smooth scrolling mods.
  • Add an optional Styler text compatibility setting, off by default. It's only needed if the text changes after the animation ends with the entire-window effect of Windows 11 File Explorer Styler.
